For the first time my league is doing an in-person draft.

I've done a bit of research and will probably use https://clickydraft.com/draftapp/ instead of a draft board.

A lot of the things I've read include having people take drinks for certain picks but I feel like that will show the draft down.

Also, best ways to pick draft order? We feel randomizing is a little boring.

Thanks!

One idea that has been in the back of my mind is to have bidding for draft order with the proceeds going to the champion prize fund. ie 100 entry league, maybe somebody would be willing to bid 10 or 20 to get 1st pick. Once you got down to a pick number that nobody wants to pay for, just randomize it from there.

Other than that, randomizing might be boring but it is completely fair and unbiased. You could have some contest but there will always be somebody that feels screwed if they aren't good at whatever the contest is. You could make it unboring as possible by drawing in reverse order.

My leagues have tossed around ideas for years about having our draft order more interesting, but in the end randomizing it is the only way to keep people from crying.

Whatever you go with, good luck!

Have had at least one in-person draft for the last 11 years.

To get draft order, everybody gets a card from a standard playing deck, and the highest card gets first pick. Ties re-draw for the higher spot.

There should be some sort of penalty for going out of turn, or picking a pre-picked player, or general stupidity. We used to do penalty shots, and still do for some issues. Other penalties include pushups, and IMO, the worst penalty is to text your mother that you did something stupid in a fantasy football draft party, and that you're sorry.

Most importantly, before the draft, we all hang out for a few hours ahead of time, BBQ, play hoseshoes, play video games, or just pre-drink and chat or whatever...

Dont worry about slowing the draft down. It's a party. Have fun.
